messages:
Amanda Chen: follow-up to packaging RFC: proposing 'slab' bundles for airgapped sites. base slab + small incremental slabs, content-addressed chunks, atomic swap on activation.

Raul Gomez: resume semantics over flaky media?

Amanda Chen: agent verifies signed index then fetches chunks with range/resume. operator stores resume token.

Jia Patel: verification: sha256 per chunk by default, optional merkle proofs for minimal transfer.

Kevin O'Neill: merkle adds CPU on low-end devices. make verifier configurable. sample config: chunk_verifier: sha256 | merkle

Amanda Chen: rollback: keep small activation journal + pinned last-known-good slab so rollback is local.

Raul Gomez: API: POST /v1/slab/index, GET /v1/slab/chunk/:hash with Accept-Ranges. agent should advertise verifier support.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: CI build-1360 produced 18 chunks, index sig OK :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/1360

Jia Patel: support 'cassette' wrapper (tarball of slabstore) for offline media that unpacks into slabs.

Amanda Chen: metrics: slab.resume.count, slab.activation.duration, slab.rollback.count.

Kevin O'Neill: I'll draft appendix for on-disk layout and CLI surface. aiming to land in packaging RFC by EOD Wed.

Amanda Chen: @Jia @Raul please review when posted.
